hana.z: spotted a staging Vault token printed in a partner CI artifact during a routine audit. It looks like an accidental debug echo in their build step.

:tom_s: can you paste the sanitized line + object path?

hana.z: sanitized: `DEBUG: received vault token va.C3xy...REDACTED...9Q` found in gs://partner-ci-logs/build-309/errors.log

devsec-bot: auto-detect: token-exposure-high -> incident SEC-1442 created.

eva-g: immediate actions: 1) revoke token; 2) rotate staging auth and wrap keys; 3) scan storage/archives for copies; 4) ask partner to purge and rotate on their side. I'll coordinate rotation.

:tom_s: revoking token now (vault token revoke -id va.C3xy...). success. Listing any child leases to revoke.

hana.z: scanning scripts: partner uses a custom step that prints raw response from our auth API when DEBUG=1. We need to update our SDK to never include raw token strings in logs and add a lint rule for CI steps.

eva-g: agreed. I'll open infra-client PR to sanitize logging and add a CI lint that fails if token-like patterns are printed. PR will also add a config flag to redact VAULT_TOKEN env values in debug output.

oncall-rota: holding all non-essential staging deploys until rotation completes. Monitoring enabled.

eva-g: rotation finished: rewrapped keys, rotated service tokens, updated staging secrets. Monitoring extra audit logs for 72h.

hana.z: found two archived objects containing the token; flagged partner and internal backup owner. Partner security notified and asked to delete artifacts and confirm.

tom_s: follow-ups: - merge client logging PR, - add lint rule, - update RBAC playbook to include log-sink viewer checks when narrowing KMS roles, - draft short postmortem.

eva-g: assigning tasks and marking SEC-1442 P1. Thanks everyone.

(End of thread)
